title: Users can export invoices as CSV
description:
Add a CSV export action to the billing workspace so finance users can download the currently filtered invoice list without leaving the application.

## Means of Compliance
| # | Acceptance Criterion | MoC | Evidence |
|---|----------------------|-----|----------|
| 1 | Finance users can download the currently filtered invoice list as CSV. | e2e | tests/billing/invoice-export.spec.ts |
| 2 | Exported CSV preserves invoice number, due date, status, and gross total columns. | integ | tests/billing/test_invoice_export_columns.py |
acceptance_criteria:
- Finance users can download the currently filtered invoice list as CSV.
- Exported CSV preserves invoice number, due date, status, and gross total columns.
